newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May machine tool orders up 27.3 yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan May machine tool orders up 27.3 yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's machine tool makers received orders worth 101.17 billion yen in May, the highest level in nearly six years and up 27.3 percent from a year ago, an industry group announced on Tuesday. The Japan Machine Tool Builders' Association said in a statement that the value of the orders had climbed to over 100 billion yen for the first time since June 1991.
Domestic demand for machine tools climbed 37.1 percent year-on-year to 56.47 billion yen, while foreign demand grew 16.8 percent to 44.70 billion yen, the group said.
